name: B10-0073/2025 (S&D) – Systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Iran's crackdown on protests, its rising use of the death penalty, and its detention of European citizens as hostages. It asks Iran to cancel the death sentences of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi and to free detained European nationals. It also asks the European Union and its member states to consider targeted sanctions and joint diplomatic efforts.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects Iranian officials facing possible sanctions and European citizens held in Iran.
- Next, the European Union and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
